title: Test: sign-then-verify roundtrip through group log
description:
No test currently verifies that the POST pipeline produces a group log entry whose operator_signature passes verify_entry(). This test would have caught o0r.2 immediately and will catch any future regression in the sign→log→verify chain.

Write an integration test in crates/reader/tests/ or crates/integration-tests/ that:
1. Stands up a reader instance with a real signing key
2. POSTs a valid article through the full pipeline (validate → sign → IPFS write → assign article number → append log)
3. Reads the resulting LogEntry from the group log storage
4. Calls core::group_log::verify::verify_entry() on it
5. Asserts the result is Ok

The test must use a real LogStorage (SQLite) and a real signing key — no mocks. Independent oracle: verify_entry() is the oracle; the test fails if the signature field is empty or does not verify.
